card.name: The word disclaimer and its pieces
card.fires_on: The word "disclaimer" (or "disclaimers"), including the middle of it when split, such as "dis-claim-ers" or "DISCLAIMER" in capitals. It appears in website notices and legal-style notes.

modes.label: Split-up disclaimer
modes.description: The pole fires on the "claim" or "ers" piece inside a broken-up "disclaimer".
modes.example: Mark any documents with appropriate confidentiality and IPR dis<<claim>>ers.

modes.label: Disclaimer as a heading
modes.description: The whole word "Disclaimer" opens a notice, often followed by a colon.
modes.example: <<Disclaimer>>: We are not able to answer specific

modes.label: Disclaimer in a link list
modes.description: The word appears in a site footer or policy link list.

card.plain: It lights up on the word "disclaimer" in website and legal notices.
